summary: Reviewed books/acl2s/ccg/ccg.lisp (358KB, 8247 lines). This is the core implementation of ACL2s's Calling Context Graph (CCG) termination analysis. It contains extensive formal mathematical content including: struct definitions for CCG/CCMF/SRG data structures; algorithms for size-change termination (SCT) and size-change principle (SCP) analysis; CCM guessing/propagation; SCC decomposition; counter-example generation; minimal measured subset computation; and full ACL2 integration (ccg-chk-acceptable-defuns, prove-termination-with-ccg, ccg-defuns-fn). The file also includes comprehensive xdoc documentation for CCG, CCG-XARGS, set-ccg-hierarchy, set-termination-method, and related topics. This is not a pure import aggregator, certification sidecar, or declaration-free file — it is the primary formalization of the CCG termination prover.
